3283.title: Delegation activity grouping
3283.rootCauseOneLine: Delegations are grouped regardless of childRef; native titles do not automatically map that reference to a BB thread link.
3283.proposedFix: Verify provider-to-BB child identity resolution before separating one visible thread link from activity detail.
3283.caveats: Grouping repeated on two clean trusted checkouts. Resolved BB child-link navigation and browser rendering were not reproduced. Full build did not complete; no fix PR. Reproduction harness and output are inline in the HTML.
